output.reason: The linked PR [ev-8ce3e0324421] explains the changelog line [ev-d031f9894360]. It is a bug fix: IPv6 addresses were joined to ports incorrectly, so the ring used `::1:7946` instead of `[::1]:7946`. The fix uses `net.JoinHostPort`, which makes IPv6-only networks work. The exposed environments are Loki deployments that use IPv6 addresses. That mainly means the frontend, plus the other address-joining spots listed in the changed files: querier worker, memcached client, consul agent and modules [ev-eb3b6a8ce9ef]. If an operator does nothing, the outcome is a fix: the bad address joins are corrected, and the workaround from issue #10532 is no longer required [ev-a5a7080634b3].
